verdict.rationale: Pipedream's docs and probe consistently claim access to 3,000+ APIs and 10,000+ tools via MCP, with per-app dedicated MCP servers (e.g., ClickUp, OpenAI, Slack) and a proxy for endpoints without pre-built tools, confirmed by an independent llms.txt probe citing 3,223 apps. Missing for 10: independent third-party verification of the exact catalog size beyond Pipedream's own docs/probe.
